# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a young woman with fair, curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully, wearing sleeve puffs that are larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic young woman who possesses a natural talent for winning and holding the affections of her pupils while bringing out the best in them mentally and morally. She is gentle and forgiving when disciplining students, preferring to talk with them about their missteps rather than resorting to physical punishment. Her teaching style keeps her classroom running with regularity and smooth order, and she maintains perfect discipline without whipping anyone.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the Avonlea school trustees as the district's first lady teacher, succeeding Mr. Phillips. Upon taking charge of Avonlea school, she introduced several new routine activities, including physical culture exercises twice daily, biweekly Friday recitation sessions, and nature 'field days' in the woods to study ferns, flowers, and birds. She taught her students English poetry by heart and held a Queen's preparation class to prepare older students for the Entrance examinations. Although rumored to be leaving after her first year to accept a teaching job in her home district's grade school, she returned to Avonlea for a second year. During her tenure, she helped correct her students' grammar and advised ambitious students, such as Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe, to take up Second Year work at Queen's Academy to earn First Class teacher's licenses in a single year. At the end of June following her second year, her term and rule at Avonlea school came to an emotional close as she gave touching farewell words to her scholars.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c29 P1](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0001), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c17 P18](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0018)_

## Background by volume

- hired by the Avonlea school trustees as the village's first female teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

> But you’ve done good work this past year, and you deserve a good, jolly vacation.
